label: Corner grids
subgoals: List process, voltage and temperature axes
Multiply the axis sizes and the Monte Carlo samples
Prune to worst corners while re-checking them as sizing changes

label: Worst-case margin
subgoals: Evaluate the spec at every corner
Take the minimum and subtract the spec
Constrain each corner separately to avoid a non-smooth minimum

label: Parametric yield
subgoals: Standardize the distance from mean to spec by sigma
Evaluate the normal CDF for the single-spec yield
Bound the joint yield by the weakest spec and estimate it jointly
